meta.title: Receptio – AI voice receptionist
meta.description: Receptio is an AI voice receptionist for small businesses. It picks up the phone, books appointments and nothing slips through.

hero.title: A receptionist who
hero.subtitle: Receptio answers the call, handles questions and sends the summary to your phone. Even at 2 a.m. Even on weekends.
hero.suitable: Built for restaurants, dental clinics, auto repair shops and hair salons

how.title: Online in 5 minutes
how.step1Text: Enter your opening hours, common questions and the tone the assistant should use.
how.step2Text: We assign you a local number, or you forward calls from your existing one.
how.step3Text: Every call is recorded, answered, and a summary reaches you by email or SMS.

roi.title: What does a single missed call cost you?
roi.conversion: Conversion rate of a missed call
roi.payback: Receptio pays for itself in {count, plural, one {# day} other {# days}}
roi.note: Estimate: missed calls × 4 weeks × customer value × conversion rate.

cases.title: Works where every call is money

restaurant.title: Restaurants & cafés
restaurant.text: Table bookings, menu questions, opening hours — without tying up a waiter.
restaurant.proof: → Around 20 booking calls a week on average

dental.title: Dental clinics
dental.proof: → 30% of calls come outside opening hours

auto.title: Auto repair shops
auto.text: Taking job requests, repair status updates, price estimates.
auto.proof: → Every second call = a new job

beauty.title: Hair & beauty salons
beauty.text: Bookings, price list, stylist availability — no picking up mid-haircut.
beauty.proof: → 40% of customers don't rebook without a reminder

footer.tagline: AI receptionist for businesses that can't afford to miss calls.

cta.title: Start free today

demo.title: This is how Receptio talks to a customer

demo.a1: Good evening! We would love to have you. What time would you like to come, and do you prefer the terrace or the indoor area?
demo.a2: Great, terrace for 4 at 7 PM – noted. What name should I put the reservation under?

security.title: We treat your data responsibly
security.i1Text: The database runs on servers in the European Union. We do not pass data to third parties for their own purposes.
security.i2Text: All communication with the app uses an encrypted connection (HTTPS/TLS). Only you and your team can see call recordings.
security.i3Text: You can delete an agent together with its entire call history and release phone numbers right in the app.
